title: Aromatic Smoky Kenyan Savoy Cabbage Tagine
description: This dish is a smoky and creamy Kenyan inspired tagine featuring savoy cabbage, with a unique wok-hei flavor, perfect for a plant-based dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until lightly browned.
Add the chopped savoy cabbage and cook for 5 minutes, until it starts to soften.
Add the smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and lemon juice, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes, until the cabbage is tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
